name: Hilary's Necklace
summary: At Lakeshire's docks, Hilary loses the necklace her father gave her. Shawn asks you to find it in Lake Everstill, where their parents forbid them to swim.

sections.title: A Day at the Docks
sections.body: Hilary and Shawn fish from Lakeshire's docks, seeking an ordinary day amid the threats around the Redridge Mountains. Then Hilary's treasured necklace slips into Lake Everstill. They search the piers and shore, but find nothing. Shawn asks you to help.

sections.title: Perils of Lake Everstill
sections.body: Their parents forbid Hilary and Shawn to swim in Lake Everstill. Aggressive murlocs and hungry threshedons lurk below the surface. The necklace lies in glinting mud at the lake bottom, beyond the children's reach. So Shawn asks you to recover the gift.

faq.answer: Hilary, a young girl in Lakeshire, lost the necklace her father gave her. His gift means a great deal to her.

faq.q: Why can't Shawn or Hilary swim down and get it themselves?
faq.answer: Their parents forbid them to swim in Lake Everstill, where aggressive murlocs and predatory threshedons lurk beneath the surface.

faq.q: Where did the necklace end up?
faq.answer: The necklace slipped from the docks and settled into a mound of glinting mud on Lake Everstill's western lake bed.
Effsee is Hilary's pet kitten in Lakeshire. She keeps Hilary company and joins her in thanking travelers who recover the necklace.

faq.q: Who starts the request to find the necklace?
faq.answer: Shawn, Hilary's friend, was fishing with her on the docks. He asks you to help because he knows how much her father's gift means to her.

faq.q: Why does this task matter to Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Finding the keepsake brings comfort and a little normalcy to Lakeshire's families, who struggle to live peacefully under constant threat.

angles.text: As an Alliance traveler, you help Lakeshire's beleaguered citizens through personal hardships. Your care for everyday townsfolk matters alongside the defense against greater threats.
